name: excalidraw-vault
description: Generate Excalidraw diagrams directly into the MoxyWolf Vault in the zsviczian Obsidian-Excalidraw plugin's native .excalidraw.md format. Diagrams open natively in Obsidian alongside the notes that reference them, embed via wikilinks in DRs/specs/decks, and stay versioned in the git-backed vault. Parallels vault-code-learn (code-axis) and graphify-vault (knowledge-axis) on the diagram axis. Carries the excalidraw-vault-core runner protocol (Obsidian-format JSON wrapping, element schema, naming conventions, routing) as the single source of truth. Built for MoxyWolf LLC internal use.
